svg.title: Five seconds between starts
svg.desc: A time-lapse example with a half-second exposure and five-second start-to-start interval. Frame one starts at zero seconds, frame two at five seconds, and frame three at ten seconds. A thirty-minute window fits 360 complete exposures. The last starts at 29 minutes 55 seconds and finishes at 29 minutes 55.5 seconds. An exposure starting at 30 minutes would finish outside the window.

g.text: The exposure is part of the interval.
Green blocks show exposures. Starts stay five seconds apart.
The last frame must finish inside.
A start at 30:00 would finish outside the window.
Ideal timing example. Allow for your camera’s processing.
HONEST LITTLE APPS · ASTERFOLD WEB COMPANION
